second_order: claiming and cheering on hcjSpicy and hcjCrab
theme_note: These passages make the figures into shared community work: people name what they made, recognise Justin, add hcjCrab, spot details, and cheer the makers. What varies is whether the speaker makes, recognises, adds to, or praises the picture.
regrouped_from: Reviewed against a narrower praise-only grouping; merged because the praise and recognition explicitly treat the figures as the room's shared work.

second_order: keeping watch and posting canvas updates
theme_note: People repeatedly preserve and report the picture's condition so others can follow it. The practice ranges from saving a snapshot for posterity and late-night checks to reporting damage, survival, and the small qualification to that survival.
regrouped_from: Reviewed against separate snapshot, live-update, and ending groups; merged because each passage keeps a public record of the picture's changing condition.

second_order: coordinating how to maintain the picture
theme_note: These turns work out what people should do to keep the picture: surrounding it, promising maintenance, asking whether to resist a background, invoking war or peace, and choosing borders while planning in Discord. What varies is the proposed tactic and whether the speaker favours fighting or coexistence.
regrouped_from: Reviewed after comparing the border exchange with the earlier maintenance call; retained together because both exchanges organise how to keep the same picture standing.

second_order: mourning and blaming after the pictures are covered
theme_note: People narrate the covering as an attack and answer it with relocation advice, sadness, blame, and an account of failed checking. The responses vary from tactical language to jokes, mourning, and calling the other people jerks.
regrouped_from: Reviewed against separating tactical relocation from emotional replies; kept together because the relocation proposal and reactions all answer the same reported covering episode.

second_order: bringing the picture back and moving it
theme_note: These passages restore or re-site the artwork and help people find it again. What varies is doing the return, celebrating it, joking about how it was saved, announcing the new location, or supplying coordinates.
regrouped_from: Reviewed against folding these passages into maintenance; kept separate because they concern recovery and relocation after loss rather than ongoing upkeep.

second_order: trying to understand an event you had to be there for
theme_note: The single passage makes sense of post-event confusion by saying the brief event required being present. It remains a single-code theme because no other passage performs this retrospective outsider reading.
regrouped_from: Grouping reviewed; retained as a single-code theme because it belongs with no other practice in the thread.

second_order: spotting another picture on the canvas
